Lesione omogeneamente iperintensa in T2,:
Lesion homogeneously hyperintense on T2, non-enhancing, in a young adult: low-grade diffuse glioma. IDH-mutant astrocytomas are typically frontal, homogeneous, with fairly sharp margins; on FLAIR the "T2-FLAIR mismatch" sign is sought (lesion homogeneous on T2 and hypointense on FLAIR centrally with a hyperintense rim), highly specific for IDH-mutant astrocytoma with intact 1p/19q.
The grade (WHO 2, 3 or 4 even in IDH-mutant tumors) and the type (astrocytoma or oligodendroglioma) are given by histology with the molecular profile. In the report: location, relationships with eloquent areas (here the superior frontal gyrus, near the supplementary motor area), size, enhancement, mass effect.
